subject: Post-PT follow-up: artifacts for mitigations and risk acceptance
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@harborfin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Harbor Security <security@harborfin.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: post-PT remediation artifacts and compensating controls

Hi Tessa / Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Harbor has reviewed the penetration test write-up you shared and we have a couple of follow-ups before we can sign off on the remediation column in our risk tracker. Specifically we need: 

- A packaged set of artifacts for the high and critical findings (screenshots, ticket links, config diffs)
- Evidence that compensating controls are in place where a code change wasn't applied (WAF rules, monitoring rules, IAM policy changes)
- An explanation of any residual risk and whether Redwood requests risk acceptance from Harbor

Can you confirm when we can expect the artifacts? Also if you have a short checklist mapping PT findings to SOC 2 control family IDs, that would accelerate internal review.

We'd like to close out the remediation review by Feb 25.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Security Program Manager
Harbor Financial
alex.mercer@harborfin.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@harborfin.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: post-PT remediation artifacts and compensating controls

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a prioritized artifact package for high/critical items by EOD Friday Feb 19, and follow up with SOC 2 mapping early next week. Quick notes / asks so we deliver exactly what you need: 

- Do you prefer screenshots embedded in a PDF or separate image files? We can do both but want to match Harbor's intake process.
- For tickets, we can share JIRA exports and/or direct links (we'll redact internal comments as needed). Confirm which you prefer.
- For compensating controls, we'll include WAF rule snapshots, the Splunk alert definitions, and a short narrative describing the compensating control effectiveness testing we performed.

Plan: Monica will assemble the artifact bundle (attachments + JIRA export). Sean will add the SOC 2 control mapping and short residual-risk statements. I'll send the package and a short README with acceptance questions by Feb 19 EOD PST. If that timeline doesn't work, tell us who on your side we should prioritize.

Thanks — 
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Lead, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0198
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@harborfin.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: post-PT remediation artifacts and compensating controls

Alex — attaching the initial artifact bundle per Tessa's plan. Attachment stubs below (full package is in the Drive link in this message):

Attachments included: redwood_pt_summary_20270212.pdf (summary with finding IDs), fix_screenshot_1.png (screenshot showing fixed input validation), config_snapshot_nginx.conf.txt (post-fix nginx config), JIRA-7890-export.csv (ticket export for high/critical findings)

Quick highlights: 
- FIND-102 (critical): input validation flaw — code patch deployed 2027-02-10; screenshot attached [attachment: fix_screenshot_1.png] and config diff in nginx snapshot. JIRA ticket JIRA-7890 has linked test cases and PR refs.
- FIND-115 (high): Brute-force protection gaps — compensating control applied via WAF rule set change (WAF rule id: WAF-445). I've exported the rule change and included a Splunk saved search name (redwood_bruteforce_detection).
- FIND-121 (high): Sensitive tokens logged — removed logging in service and added log-redaction rule; sample log screenshot redacted and included.

Notes on redaction: we removed any customer PII from screenshots and ticket exports. If Harbor needs unredacted artifacts for audit reasons, we'll coordinate an NDA addendum and transfer via secure ShareFile.

Drive (full package): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFgHIjk-example
JIRA board filter: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-7890

--
Monica Patel
Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@harborfin.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Gina Wu <gina.wu@harborfin.com>, Harbor Security <security@harborfin.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: post-PT remediation artifacts and compensating controls

Tessa / Monica — thanks for the fast turnaround and the package. We reviewed the summary and the provided artifacts; a few items before we can mark the findings as remediated in our tracker: 

- For FIND-102 we need the test case (QA steps) used to verify the fix in a non-prod environment, and the PR link that shows the code change. The JIRA export references the PR but the link is behind your company's GitHub; can you provide the PR number or paste the diff into the Drive folder?
- For FIND-115 the WAF rule details are good but we need evidence of production rollout and the monitoring alert that would catch any regression (Splunk alert ID or screenshot).
- For FIND-121 please provide the log-redaction test results (before/after sample with masked fields) — redacted copies are fine if you keep the mapping notes internal.

If it's easier, could Redwood provide a single PDF with: (a) per-finding artifact checklist, (b) links to each supporting artifact (Drive/JIRA/PR), and (c) a one-paragraph residual risk statement for each finding? That package will allow our GRC team to triage quickly.

Assignees on our side: Gina Wu will be the reviewer for the artifacts. If you can get the consolidated PDF by Monday Feb 22 we should be able to complete our internal sign-off by Feb 25 as requested.

Appreciate the cooperation —
Alex
Security Program Manager
Harbor Financial
